section5.description: Find quick answers to common questions about Too Fresh To Waste. We're here to help you save food and money with ease.

faq1.question: How does Too Fresh To Waste work?
faq1.answer: Too Fresh To Waste connects you with local restaurants, bakeries, hotels, and grocery stores that have surplus food. Browse offers near you, reserve your meal, pay securely, and pick it up at the designated time or choose home delivery. It's that simple!

faq2.question: What is the business solution?
faq2.answer:
PROFIT FROM YOUR SURPLUS FOOD

Our marketplace connects your business with users across Tunisia - all eager to buy surplus food.

faq3.question: What is the big prize?
faq3.answer: The Big Prize is a high-value reward awarded every 3-4 months to the 10 most active users in Tunisia. The prize may include phones, electric scooters, smart watches, and other valuable gifts announced before each event.

faq4.question: How do I get the big prize?
faq4.answer:
Buying surprise bags
Referring friends or businesses
Leaving honest reviews
Buying multiple bags in a short time
Logging in daily for 15 consecutive days

urgency.body: CBAM, the EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive, and Tunisia's emerging ESG alignment with ISO 26000 mean inaction is now a financial liability — not just an ethical choice.

items.title: ESG Reporting
items.body: Demonstrate measurable environmental and social impact to investors, auditors, and regulators.

items.title: Scope 3 Emissions

items.title: CBAM

items.title: ISO 14001

items.title: ODD / SDGs

meta.title: Humanity Mission | Too Fresh To Waste
meta.description: 5% of every profit goes to those who need it most — food, medicine, education, and warmth for Tunisia's most vulnerable.

hero.headline: Nourishing Bodies. Nurturing Lives.
hero.sub: At Too Fresh To Waste, our mission goes beyond the lunch table. We believe that every meal saved should help save a life in our community.

pledge.headline: Our 5% Profit Pledge.
pledge.body: True change doesn't ask you to pay extra. We automatically dedicate 5% of our net profits from every surplus bag sold on our marketplace. Whether you are buying a meal or selling one, you are actively funding human dignity — without spending a single extra dinar.

items.title: Zero Hungry Nights
items.body: We transform food waste revenue into actual groceries and meals for families facing extreme poverty. No family should ever have to put their young children to bed hungry.

items.title: Dignity for the Elderly
items.body: Many grandparents cannot afford essential treatments. We directly fund pharmacies to cover the cost of chronic medications for elderly patients without a safety net.

items.title: Empowering the Next Generation
items.body: A bright mind should never be kept out of the classroom due to a lack of funds. We provide school supplies and cover education fees so children can build a better future.

items.title: Warmth & Care
items.body: Every season brings new hardships. We provide essential clothing to ensure that vulnerable individuals and families stay warm, protected, and treated with respect.

partner.headline: Fueled by Tunisian Businesses.
partner.body: This impact is entirely made possible by the restaurants, bakeries, hotels, patisseries, grocery stores, supermarkets, and enterprise companies using our app. Every time your company uses Too Fresh To Waste, you receive a monthly impact report showing exactly how many lives your daily operations helped transform.

hero.subtitle: The Parcless Bag transforms your unsold stock and production surplus into real revenue — while reducing your environmental footprint and feeding Tunisian families.

concept.label: The concept
concept.body1: The Parcless Bag is an anti-waste solution designed for Tunisian manufacturers. You package your unsold items, surplus or products near their expiry date in a discounted mystery bag. Consumers buy it through our app — and everyone wins.
concept.body2: Inspired by the global success of Too Good To Go, the Parcless Bag is adapted to Tunisian market realities: local logistics, consumption habits and strong social impact.
concept.statDesc: of partner manufacturers reduce their food waste rate by 70 to 80% in under 3 months.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps to turn your surplus into revenue and your commitment into real impact.

steps.title: You prepare the bag
steps.body: Each evening — or at your chosen frequency — your teams package the day's surplus in a standardised Parcless Bag. Real value: 2 to 3× the selling price on the app.

steps.title: Customers reserve
steps.body: Your offer appears on Too Fresh To Waste. Local consumers reserve and pay through the app. Zero additional sales management on your side.

steps.title: You get paid
steps.body: Payment is sent directly. Access your real-time data: bags sold, revenue generated, CO₂ avoided — a full ESG dashboard included.

benefits.label: Why join
benefits.subtitle: Designed for the realities of Tunisian manufacturers.

items.title: Revenue from the unsellable
items.body: Turn every unsold unit into cash. The items you used to throw away represent a dead loss — the Parcless Bag converts them into an additional revenue stream with no extra sales effort.

items.title: Zero Waste Label
items.body: Earn a recognised ESG certification. Display your commitment on your packaging, marketing materials and public tenders.

items.title: Real-time dashboard
items.body: Visualise your anti-waste performance, your revenue by period, and your saved carbon footprint — month by month.

items.title: 48h integration
items.body: Our team handles everything. Onboarding, training, dedicated support. You are operational in two working days.

items.title: Tax advantage
items.body: Food donations benefit from tax advantages in Tunisia. Our documentation simplifies your annual declarations.

items.title: Local visibility
items.body: Be visible to thousands of engaged consumers — a premium audience sensitive to quality and sustainability.

quote.text: In Tunisia, 30% of food production ends up in the bin before even reaching the consumer. Together, let's change that statistic.
